_about: One party model, engine E2 (logic wave 3). Each case runs the real sites that count a party (the Explore way-there car, the Places drive, the planner's hire, the day card's car line, the footprint of a car, the day budget, the style and planner caps, the party kind) and states what each screen prints. Cars: Annecy from Brussels (the audit's own probe P8) for Explore and Places, Barcelona for the planner and the day card. Owner default 2 (2026-11-23): a baby under 2 takes a car seat on every screen, a child is 2 to 11, a teen 12 to 17 is priced as an adult and keeps kind family. 'current' is a regression guard; 'target' fails until E2 is on.

cases.source: B-9 probe P8: 4 adults and a baby are one car on Explore and Places and two in the planner; owner default 2, the baby takes a seat, so two everywhere
B-9: five car seats are two cars on every screen
Four adults fill one car of four (car.model car_capacity) on every screen
A family of four is one car
V6: seven people are two cars on every screen
B-10: a party that needs two cars emits two cars' grams shared over its seats: 800 km x 162 g x 2 cars / 4 seats = 64.8 kg
B-10: six adults are two cars, 800 x 162 x 2 / 6 = 43.2 kg; the cap of 5 seats shared one car's grams over five and gave 25.9
D22: 800 km x 162 g / 4 seats = 32.4 kg, one full car
D22: a couple in one car, 800 x 162 / 2 = 64.8 kg
H-8 and V-9: a day budget is for adults plus children; (700 + 500) / 2 heads / 7 nights = 85.7, within 90 by 4; dividing by the two babies too gave 42.9
Children count in the day budget's divisor (owner default 2): 1200 / 4 / 7 = 42.9, within 90 by 47
G-8: two adults and two teens (13 and 15) are a family; owner default 2, teens priced as adults and kind family
A baby under 2 makes a family
G-10 (W0b): a couple style with five adults is friends, not a couple
G-9: one cap for every screen (config party.limits max_babies 4); the planner and the style took 7
Under the cap every screen keeps the number
